account-access-runtime.unsupported: Account Access Runtime signs requests with bearer tokens, not AWS credentials.

cloudfront-keyvaluestore.unsupported: CloudFront KeyValueStore: KVS ARN must be provided to use this service

cloudwatchomni.unsupported: CloudWatchOmni speaks only rpcv2Cbor, which aws_api_read and aws_api_change don't send yet.

codecatalyst.unsupported: CodeCatalyst signs requests with bearer tokens, not AWS credentials.

eventbridgev2.unsupported: EventBridgeV2 speaks only rpcv2Cbor, which aws_api_read and aws_api_change don't send yet.

partnercentral-revenue-measurement.unsupported: PartnerCentral Revenue Measurement speaks only rpcv2Cbor, which aws_api_read and aws_api_change don't send yet.

s3.unsupported: S3 has its own addressing and object rules, so aws_api_read and aws_api_change don't call it. Use an S3 object storage connection's s3_* tools for buckets and objects; if this endpoint has none, ask the user to add one.

s3control.unsupported: S3 Control needs account host labels and request checksums, which aws_api_read and aws_api_change don't send.
